additional_info.subject: RE: ID0471947-DC/Si-D/ES-[Y2/S3 300000004076] OCPP logs issue CRM:03056000942
additional_info.body:
Hi Priscilla,
Yesterday  customer contact again and told:
“
Your peep files does indeed show the boot up and initialization sequence for both chargers. However, what we can see is that the parameter “MeterValuesSampledData” is not one of the parameters we change or configure during this sequence, rather it is a parameter that is already configured on the chargers which we only read. Currently, our platform does not support changing or configuring this parameter.
Considering that the two chargers are the same model but contain differing configurations, then the configuration is not a factory setting and must have been configured on at least one of the chargers at some point before the problem started. I recommend that you contact the supplier or technician who performed the setup of the chargers and have them re-configure the charger with the problem so that the parameter “MeterValuesSampledData” matches the charger that is working as intended.”
I understand our position but also is true that if the chargers are configured the same way and OCPP are not change or configuring the “MeterValuesSampledData” somethingelse must be wrong.
Could you let us know something more about?
With best regards,

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0471947-DC/Si-D/ES-[Y2/S3 300000004076] OCPP logs issue CRM:03209000098
additional_info.body:
Dear Roberto,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0471947
related to MeterValueSampleData discrepancy between two chargers at Gas&Go Valcarcel.
I read the previous conversation with my colleague, and the colleague's analysis is correct. In principle, it is the OCPP Backend to set this OCPP key. If no key is set by the Backend, the key is set to a standard value. Normally, there are #2 ways to configure this OCPP key:
The Backend has a section where you can modify the values of all keys.
You can set the MeterValueSampleData via "ChangeConfiguration.req".
There is also a third way to change the MeterValueSampleData, which is modifying the Charger-config.json file via ssh.
Until FW<
v8.0.5,
this change of configuration was possible, but at every reboot the value was overwritten by the default configuration set from the Backend. If the Backend was not sending the same values for this key, the change would have been lost.
Since FW v
8.0.5
, it is possible to modify remotely the keys of Charger-config.json and these will not be overwritten. I just performed the following change, according to what I understood from the previous email:
Charger
Y2/S3 300000004076
has the desired values of MeterValueSampleData:
Charger
Y2 / S3 300000004065
has the incorrect values of MeterValueSampleData:
I just performed the configuration change on the charger-config.json file of
Y2 / S3 300000004065
and now it should be as desired:
Please confirm to me if this change of MeterValueSampleData has been performed as requested. Also, please let me know if now the Backend receives the desired data, during future charging sessions.
Please be aware that, if the Backend will send to the charger a ChangeConfiguration for this parameter, the key will be overwritten if not set from Backend side in the same way.
I would recommend to perform a GetConfiguration.req from Backend side, so to have this key configured in the Backend as well.
Looking forward to hearing feedback form you.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
